payload.summary: Removed three automatic first-run dialogs. POCUT is the visible brand in the website, editor and Electron package. Existing storage paths, protocol identifiers and project upgrade/confirmation flows are preserved. New editor shell defaults to dark with the existing POCUT violet palette and preserves explicit light selection. Both production builds passed. Fresh standalone Chrome and packaged Windows Electron smoke passed, including panel resizing, text insertion, undo/redo, project reopen, export controls and theme persistence. 82 canonical editor, 15 targeted web and 9 Electron tests passed. No deployment performed. Installed DIP rejected configured finish because of unsupported project schema.
